V_PO_FINAL_DELIVERY_APT.@EndUserText.label: PO Final Delivery APT
V_PO_FINAL_DELIVERY_APT.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
    "PURCHASEORDER",
    MAX("POSTINGDATE") AS "FINAL_DELIVERY_DATE"
FROM "ZIPOHISTEXT"
WHERE "GOODSMOVEMENTTYPE" = '101'
  AND "POSTINGDATE" IS NOT NULL
  AND "POSTINGDATE" <> ''
  AND "POSTINGDATE" <> '00000000'
GROUP BY
    "PURCHASEORDER"
